title: The question in the agent's reply whose answer changes a record

questions.description: The one question the reply puts to the person whose answer would confirm, reject or change a record, choose a conflict's side or settle a stale link; empty when there is none.

question.description: The question as the reply asks it.

label.description: The option as the reply words it.

effect.description: What choosing it does to the record: accepted confirms it as it reads, rejected drops it, change rewords or otherwise changes it.

consequence.description: One line: what choosing it means.

records.description: Ids of the records the question is about, as given in records.
